title: Ensobi okuva mu mbeera
description: Chat eno etuuse ku AI’s memory limit, nga whiteboard ejjula. Tusobola okugaziya eddirisa ly’ekijjukizo (eriyitibwa sayizi y’embeera) lisobole okujjukira ebisingawo, naye liyinza okukozesa ekijjukizo kya kompyuta yo ekisingawo. Tusobola n’okusalako ekiyingizibwa, ekitegeeza nti kijja kwerabira ebimu ku byafaayo by’emboozi okusobola okufuna ekifo ky’obubaka obupya.
contextOverflowDetail: Okusaba kuno kwali kwetaaga {{request}} obubonero, naye eddirisa ly’embeera y’ekyokulabirako likwata {{context}} yokka.
emptyReply: Model yamaliriza nga tazzeemu kuddamu. Gezaako okuddamu okukola, oba kebera ensengeka z'omugabi.

engine.unknown: Yingini ya model yaloopa ensobi gye yali tesuubira.
engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Enzimba ya model eno tewagirwa yingini eriwo kati. Okulongoosa yingini okuva mu Settings kiyinza okwongera obuwagizi.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Model yatwaala ekiseera kiwanvu nnyo okutikka era n’eyimirizibwa. Model entono oba context size entono etera okuyamba.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: Etterekero yingini lye yeetaaga libula, kale tesobola kutandika.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Ddereeva wo wa GPU mukadde nnyo ku yingini eno. Okulongoosa ddereeva, oba okukyusa ku yingini ya CPU mu Settings, kijja kutereeza kino.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: Tewali memory emala kuddukanya model eno. Model entono oba context size entono etera okuyamba.
engine.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Emu ku settings za model si ntuufu.
engine.IO_ERROR: Fayiro teyasobodde kusomebwa oba kuwandiikibwa nga otandika model.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: Waliwo ekikyamu munda mu Novera nga batandika model.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Yingini ya llama.cpp ekola, naye Novera tesobola kugiyunga ku kompyuta eno (127.0.0.1). VPN, proxy oba software y'obukuumi eyinza okuba nga eziyiza emikutu gy'omu kitundu.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: Yingini ya llama.cpp yayimirira nga tosuubira. Okuddamu okuweereza obubaka kiddamu okubutandika; singa esigala ng’eyimiridde, pulogulaamu y’ebyokwerinda oba ddereeva wa GPU eyinza okuba nga y’evuddeko.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Ebika bya wano tebiwagirwa ku processor ya kompyuta eno. Yingini ya Novera eya wano yazimbibwa ku Apple Silicon Macs (M1 oba empya), kale tesobola kutandika ku Intel Mac. Abagaba ebire ne custom bakyakola.

serverPortOccupiedDescription: Omwalo {{port}} gwakozesebwa dda. Nsaba ogezeeko omwalo ogw'enjawulo.
serverInvalidModelPath: Ekkubo ly’ekyokulabirako eritali ntuufu oba eritatuukirirwa
